Question: What are the rules regarding academic probation?
Expected_Behavior: Answer using academic regulations and cite the source.
Agent_Answer:
The rules regarding academic probation at IIT Jodhpur are as follows:  
1. A student is placed on academic probation if they fail to earn a minimum of 12 credits in any registered semester from the third semester onward [Source: 01_academic_regulations_2019.pdf, p. 18].  
2. Students on probation are monitored through mandatory attendance, special tutorials, and mentoring under a senior student [Source: 01_academic_regulations_2019.pdf, p. 18].  
3. If a student remains on academic probation for two consecutive registered semesters, their registration will be terminated [Source: 01_academic_regulations_2019.pdf, p. 18].  
4. A warning is issued to a student who earns less than or equal to 15 credits in any registered semester, with intimation sent to their parents [Source: 01_academic_regulations_2019.pdf, p. 18].  
5. The two semesters spent on academic probation count toward the maximum duration of the program [Source: 01_academic_regulations_2019.pdf, p. 18].
Notes: Provides probation criteria with citations.
